sections.heading: Driver in incident occasioning property damage to stop and give information
sections.text:
55.	Driver in incident occasioning property damage to stop and give information

	(1)	The driver of a vehicle that is involved in an incident on a road or in a road related area owing to which damage is occasioned to property shall —

		(a)	stop; and

		(b)	if any person who has reasonable grounds for so requesting is present at the scene of the incident, give to that person —

			(i)	the driver's name and address;

			(ii)	the name and address of the owner of the vehicle; and

			(iii)	the identification of the vehicle.

	(2)	A driver who fails to comply with subsection (1) commits an offence.

	Penalty for this subsection: a fine of 60 PU.

sections.heading: Driver in incident occasioning bodily harm or property damage to report incident to police
sections.text:
56.	Driver in incident occasioning bodily harm or property damage to report incident to police

	(1)	The driver of a vehicle that is involved in an incident on a road or in a road related area owing to which bodily harm is occasioned to any person or damage is occasioned to property shall, as soon as is practicable, report the incident to a member of the Police Force.

	(2)	A driver who fails to comply with subsection (1) commits an offence.

	Penalty for this subsection: a fine of 60 PU.
